name: NEXUS MD
description: NEXUS MD WhatsApp bot by Arnold Adez

BOT_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number the bot links to (country code, digits only). The pair code appears in the app logs.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your number for owner commands (digits only, comma separated for more).

SUPABASE_URL.description: Supabase project URL (keeps the WhatsApp login between restarts)

APP_URL.description: Your app URL, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com (stops it sleeping)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Claude key for AI + image commands (optional)

COBALT_API_URL.description: Your cobalt server URL for Facebook/Instagram/Twitter/YouTube downloads (optional)

COBALT_API_KEY.description: cobalt key, only if your server needs one (optional)
